static_traits.name: Wang Peiqi
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友，但尚not yet与其讨论这些具体想法；与潜在伴侣的关系受自尊问题影响；Work表现not yet受影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往not yet有类似问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 首次咨询略紧张；Positive attitude、配合度高；表达清晰、逻辑性较好；能自我觉察与Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信do not人觉得我not漂亮，这影响了我的自尊与自信，尤其是在寻找结婚伴侣的过程中；我常常Self-doubt并感到自己not具吸引力，主要在社交或初次见面时出现。
basic_info.core_demands: 'I am willing to do anything to make myself feel better and boost my confidence.'

special_situations.event: When in social settings or meeting strangers for the first time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我外表not够漂亮，do not人就会not愿与我交谈或发展关系
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Enhances confidence through makeup and styling; over-invests in appearance management before going out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这里的人大概都觉得我not好看，not想和我说话

special_situations.event: The phase of actively looking for a marriage partner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人根据外貌评判我并觉得我not漂亮，我就without法找到伴侣
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在约会或认识新朋友前Reinforcement外貌修饰；回避向朋友透露这些想法以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会根据外貌来判断我，觉得我not够漂亮

special_situations.event: At gatherings or in public, notices she receives less attention compared with others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我得到的关注少，就证明我not漂亮、not如do not人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-criticism and invests further in appearance grooming to 'catch up' with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others漂亮

special_situations.event: During interactions with a potential partner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not够漂亮，就not会被选为伴侣并可能遭到拒绝
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在互动前Over-preparation外貌；社交中谨慎、减少主动表达以避免Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他大概not会对我有兴趣，因为我not好看

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and appreciated and to build a stable intimate relationship with a partner
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因外貌被评判与拒绝，体验羞耻与not被选择的痛苦
defense_goal: 通过过度修饰外表来降低Being rejected风险
Avoids revealing true thoughts to friends to reduce the possibility of being judged
在社交中保持谨慎与Self-monitoring以维持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 自卑、需要通过外貌Gaining recognition的自我
object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially potential partners) are experienced as harsh judges

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite her to share shameful thoughts related to appearance, or when she feels watched and compared in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识将他人视为评判者，认为对方会觉得自己浅薄或not好看（移情：他人=批判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、接纳的语气，先Empathy其羞耻与担忧，再以开放式问题Guidance其具体化证据与体验；避免评判与过度Interpretation，保持节奏缓慢与安全感的建立。

manifestations: 强烈渴望找到婚姻伴侣以对抗Loneliness感
Worries about being judged by appearance in social settings and initiates conversation less
因羞耻而not向朋友透露真实想法
outcomes: Excessive investment in appearance and time spent

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Admitting nervousness in sessions, expressing cautiously
Spending excessive time on grooming before going out to ensure being 'up to standard'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 将他人的目光或关注度not足Interpretation为“他们觉得我not漂亮”
On first meeting, assumes others will negatively evaluate his appearance

positive_force: Willing to seek help and actively cooperate with counseling, strong motivation
Has a supportive network of friends（有几位亲密朋友）
Stable work performance; daily functioning maintained
Able to notice and begin questioning negative automatic thoughts (acknowledges the lack of evidence and sees contrary evidence)
negative_force: Frequent mind reading and jumping to conclusions, excessive concern with others' evaluations
Over-invests in appearance management to seek temporary relief, causing time consumption
羞耻与Being rejected的Fear导致与潜在伴侣互动受影响

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive grooming before and after social events (makeup and styling take a long time)
antecedent: When approaching social events or meeting strangers for the first time
Preparing to interact with a potential partner
target_behavior.core_reason: 基于“do not人觉得我not漂亮”的信念，以外貌修饰作为补偿来缓解Anxiety与not安全感
target_behavior.function: 寻求外部认可、暂时降低Being rejected的Fear
target_behavior.consequence: Disrupts daily routines, consumes time and energy, still hard to stably raise self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 在Social situations出现显著的Anxiety与Self-doubt，减少主动交流
antecedent: Being in social settings or meeting new friends for the first time
Noticing that others pay little attention to oneself
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind reading and jumping to conclusions, predicting that others will reject me because of my appearance and feeling ashamed
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential rejection and shame, protecting self-esteem in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: 与潜在伴侣的关系受影响，错失互动机会，Decreased sense of self-worth
